commands.name: stretch
commands.description: Turn stretch replies on or off, open or close every stretch in the latest reply, or set the short reply length
commands.output: stretch is on, and a short reply is 150 words at most. Usage: /stretch on | off | open-all | close-all | words N. on and off decide whether replies use the markup, and last across sessions; open-all and close-all open or close every stretch in the latest reply; words N sets how many words a short reply may take (10 to 2000), words alone shows the count, and words default forgets the one set here.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
/stretch → stretch is on, and a short reply is 150 words at most. Usage: /stretch on | off …
